title: Keys for Spiritual Maturity and Relational Unity
speaker: Pastor Josh Smith
takeaway: Spiritual maturity and relational unity grow through grace — enduring conflict patiently, pursuing peace persistently, serving others with God-given gifts, reaching maturity through active ministry, discerning false teaching, and speaking the truth in love.

blocks.text: 1. Allow grace to change your conflict management

"I therefore, a prisoner for the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling to which you have been called. Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, making allowance for each other's faults because of your love. Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace. There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called; one Lord, one faith, one baptism; one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all." -Ephesians 4:1-6
Patiently endure instead of putting up or pulling away
"If possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all." -Romans 12:18

"But to each one of us grace has been given as Christ apportioned it.This is why it says: "When he ascended on high, he took many captives and gave gifts to his people." (What does "he ascended" mean except that he also descended to the lower, earthly regions? He who descended is the very one who ascended higher than all the heavens, in order to fill the whole universe.) So Christ himself gave the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, the pastors and teachers, to equip his people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God and become mature, attaining to the whole measure of the fullness of Christ." -Ephesians 4:7-13
You are gifted to do good for others
Active ministry is required for maturity
"The Son of Man did not come to be served but to serve and give His life as a ransom for many." -Mark 10:45
Understand growth is impossible without truth and love together

"Then we will no longer be infants, tossed back and forth by the waves, and blown here and there by every wind of teaching and by the cunning and craftiness of people in their deceitful scheming. 15 Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will grow to become in every respect the mature body of him who is the head, that is, Christ. 16 From him the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love, as each part does its work." -Ephesians 4:14-16
"The Word became flesh and dwelt among us full of grace and truth." -John 1:14
